<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or requesting department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitRequest"
                      name="Submit IT solution request"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Requester"
                      targetRef="Start_RequestReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_IT">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RequestReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Procure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Install</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Rollout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TroubleshootingSupport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_Approval_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Testing successful?" default="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training" name="Provide training?" default="Flow_Training_NotProvided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_NotProvided</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_ToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Continue after training choice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_ToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_NotProvided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TroubleshootingSupport" name="Remain available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_Complete</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TestUnsuccessful" name="Testing unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complete" name="Solution rolled out">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_Complete</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Assess" sourceRef="Start_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Approval" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="End_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Successful" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_Rollout">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testingSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful" name="Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="End_TestUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Provided" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">trainingProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_NotProvided" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_ToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_TroubleshootingSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_Complete" sourceRef="Task_TroubleshootingSupport" targetRef="End_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester"
                      name="Employee or requesting department"
                      processRef="Process_Requester"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT"
                      name="IT"
                      processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitRequest"
                      name="Submit IT solution request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest"
                      targetRef="Start_RequestReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Requester"
                name="Submit IT solution request"
                isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Requester">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Requester" name="Employee or requesting department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RequestInitiation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestInitiation">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequesterStart_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request for an IT solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequesterStart_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_RequesterEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RequestSubmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_RequesterEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequesterStart_Submit"
                       sourceRef="Start_RequestInitiation"
                       targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>

                       sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest"
                       targetRef="End_RequestSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateCost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Procure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Install</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Rollout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TroubleshootingSupport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval"

                           default="Flow_Approval_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Resources_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult"

                           default="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training"
                           name="Provide training?"
                           default="Flow_Training_NotProvided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_NotProvided</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_ToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Merge training paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_ToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_NotProvided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TroubleshootingSupport"
               name="Remain available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TestUnsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupportAvailable" name="IT support available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Compatibility"
                       sourceRef="Start_RequestReceived"
                       targetRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compatibility_Cost"
                       sourceRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"
                       targetRef="Task_EvaluateCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cost_Resources"
                       sourceRef="Task_EvaluateCost"
                       targetRef="Task_EvaluateResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resources_Approval"
                       sourceRef="Task_EvaluateResources"
                       targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Approved"
                       name="Approved"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_Approval"
                       targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_Approval"
                       targetRef="End_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install"
                       sourceRef="Task_Procure"
                       targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test"
                       sourceRef="Task_Install"
                       targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result"
                       sourceRef="Task_Test"
                       targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Successful"
                       name="Successful"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult"
                       targetRef="Task_Rollout">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testingSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult"
                       targetRef="End_TestUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice"
                       sourceRef="Task_Rollout"
                       targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Provided"
                       name="Training provided"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_Training"
                       targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">trainingProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_NotProvided"
                       name="No training"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_Training"
                       targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_ToMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining"
                       targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"
                       targetRef="Task_TroubleshootingSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End"
                       sourceRef="Task_TroubleshootingSupport"
                       targetRef="End_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or requesting department" processRef="Process_Requester"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitRequest"
                      name="Submit IT solution request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest"
                      targetRef="Start_RequestReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Requester" name="Submit IT solution request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Requester">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Requester" name="Employee or requesting department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RequestInitiation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestInitiation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request for an IT solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestInitiation_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RequestSubmitted" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestInitiation_Submit" sourceRef="Start_RequestInitiation" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_RequestSubmitted" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="End_RequestSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="Assess and deploy IT solution" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_IT">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RequestReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCompatibility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateCost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Procure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Install</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Rollout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TroubleshootingSupport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoFurtherAction_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoFurtherAction_Testing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestReceived_Compatibility</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCompatibility" name="Check compatibility with existing systems">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestReceived_Compatibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Compatibility_Cost</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateCost" name="Evaluate cost">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Compatibility_Cost</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cost_Resources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateResources" name="Evaluate resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cost_Resources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Resources_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_Approval_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Resources_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Testing successful?" default="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training" name="Provide training?" default="Flow_Training_NotProvided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_NotProvided</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_ToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Merge training paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_ToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_NotProvided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TroubleshootingSupport" name="Remain available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoFurtherAction_Approval" name="No further action specified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoFurtherAction_Testing" name="No further action specified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupportAvailable" name="Solution rolled out and IT support available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestReceived_Compatibility" sourceRef="Start_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compatibility_Cost" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompatibility" targetRef="Task_EvaluateCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cost_Resources" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateCost" targetRef="Task_EvaluateResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resources_Approval" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateResources" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="End_NoFurtherAction_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Successful" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_Rollout">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testingSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful" name="Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="End_NoFurtherAction_Testing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Provided" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">trainingProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_NotProvided" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_ToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_TroubleshootingSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_TroubleshootingSupport" targetRef="End_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
